name: print
description: Print-specific changes: page breaks, margins, PDF optimization

prompts.prompt: Add CSS page-break-before or break-before rules so each major section starts on a new page when printed.
prompts.expectedBehavior: Page break CSS added, structure unchanged

prompts.prompt: Add CSS rules to prevent headings from being orphaned at the bottom of pages. Keep headings together with their following content.
Add a @page CSS rule with 1 inch margins on all sides for print output.
If there are tables, ensure they have visible borders and repeat header rows on each page when printed. Use border-collapse and appropriate cell padding.
Add a print-only running header that appears at the top of each printed page with the document title.
